references.author: Welcome to Thailand
references.description: Chedi principal (stupa ; reliquaire) coiffé d'une flamme en forme de fleur de lotus en bouton. Le roi Li Thaï y aurait placé un cheveu et une vertèbre du Bouddha. A sa base, il y a la frise en stuc des disciples de Bouddha.

structure_checkpoints: Portrait 1024x1536. Draw ONLY the CENTRAL lotus-bud chedi of Wat Mahathat in Sukhothai in the photo: pointed slender finial above bulbous lotus bud, cylindrical neck, stepped square body, decorated arched front niche and directly supporting sculpted tiered base with procession relief. Remove all freestanding round foreground columns and flanking stupas; keep the actual main chedi and its support complete. No invented roofs on this ruin.
material_observations: 灰褐旧砖石，灰黑风化表面，塔身局部浅赭灰泥，底座砖偏红褐。
source_note: 依据所列实拍进行艺术简化；范围为莲苞形主塔及直接支承台基。原型待用户人眼验收，不作实测或文保复原声明。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, visible counts, openings, proportions and perspective.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK line drawing on a perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE (#FFFFFF) background. Use confident fine contours and a few finer internal structural lines. All unmarked surfaces inside and outside remain pure white; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, broad grey shading, crosshatching, pencil grain, paper texture, gradient, color, gold, halo, cast shadow or checkerboard. Draw only ink strokes; the white background will be removed by a local script.
Show the entire selected subject, centered, verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, scaffolding, fences, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve ornament selectively without every brick or roof tile. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border. Subject occupies about 82% of canvas width/height, apex and base uncut, with generous balanced margins.
SPECIFIC SUBJECT AND SCOPE: Portrait 1024x1536. Remove all freestanding round foreground columns and flanking stupas; keep the actual main chedi and its support complete. No invented roofs on this ruin.
